name: 3U Primary Structure
description: Aluminium frame, rails and fasteners for a 3U-form-factor spacecraft bus.
rationale: Educational estimate for a 3U educational satellite structure, covering rails, stack plates and fasteners. Not a manufacturer specification.

name: 6U Primary Structure
description: Larger aluminium frame for a 6U-form-factor spacecraft bus with more payload volume.
rationale: Educational estimate scaled from the 3U educational frame assumption. Not a manufacturer specification.

name: Body-Mounted Solar Array
description: Body-mounted silicon cells providing modest orbit-average power without deployable mechanisms.
rationale: Educational estimate of beginning-of-life orbit-average generation for body-mounted cells on a 3U bus, assuming partial illumination. Not a qualified array specification.

name: Deployable Solar Array
description: Two deployable panels with higher generation at the cost of mass and deployment complexity.
rationale: Educational estimate of beginning-of-life orbit-average generation for two small deployable panels. Not a qualified array specification.

name: Li-ion Battery Pack (40 Wh)
description: Battery pack sized for eclipse operations and load smoothing.
rationale: Educational estimate for a 40 Wh space-rated Li-ion pack. Charge and discharge losses are not modelled in this budget; mass and cost are included.

name: UHF Transceiver
description: Low-power UHF radio for telemetry and low-rate data downlink.
rationale: Educational estimate of transmit-mode power, mass and cost for a small UHF transceiver. Not a datasheet value.

name: S-Band Transmitter
description: Higher-rate S-band downlink for image data.
rationale: Educational estimate of transmit-mode power, mass and cost for a small S-band transmitter. Not a datasheet value.

name: High-Gain Antenna
description: Directional antenna that supports the higher-rate downlink.
rationale: Passive antenna with no modelled power draw. Mass and cost are educational estimates.

name: Flight Computer
description: Command and data handling computer for payload scheduling and telemetry.
rationale: Educational estimate of average power, mass and cost for a small flight computer. Not a datasheet value.

name: Avionics Interface Board
description: Adds payload and radio interface channels to the flight computer.
rationale: Educational estimate for an interface board. Not a datasheet value.

name: Multispectral Imager
description: Four-band Earth-observation camera for land and vegetation imaging.
rationale: Educational estimate of a small multispectral imager. The optical model and ground sample distance calculation are introduced in the orbit milestone; no vendor specification is claimed.

name: High-Resolution Imager
description: Higher-resolution camera with greater mass, power and cost.
rationale: Educational estimate of a higher-resolution imager. No vendor specification is claimed.

name: Cold-Gas Thruster Module
description: Small cold-gas module for attitude and orbit adjustments.
rationale: Educational estimate including tank, valves and control electronics. Propellant mass and delta-v are not modelled in the MVP; power is an averaged budget allowance.

name: Passive Thermal Kit
description: Multi-layer insulation, coatings and radiators without powered heaters.
rationale: Educational estimate for passive thermal hardware. No powered heaters, so no electrical load is modelled.

name: Active Thermal Control
description: Thermostatted heaters and sensors for tighter temperature control.
rationale: Educational estimate of average heater power, mass and cost. Not a qualified thermal design.
